extraction.policy_summary: The Company states it has an equal opportunity policy 'in line with Right of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016' that 'fosters an environment where all our people feel like they can learn, contribute and grow,' and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of, among other characteristics, disability.
extraction.accommodation_process_summary: The Company's DE&I Council partnered with external agencies to conduct 'PwD job mapping as well as facility access audit to facilitate a comfortable work environment for all and made locations accessible.'
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: FY2025-26: 0 (Nil) differently abled employees (permanent or other than permanent); 34 differently abled workers (8 permanent + 26 other than permanent), all reported male (100%).
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Company states it conducted a facility access audit via its DE&I Council partnering with key agencies and 'made locations accessible.' Separately for visitors, it states it 'has undertaken an access audit to determine level of modifications required for upgrading infrastructure' and that 'in certain locations... office premises and infrastructure continues to modify to enable a comfortable working environment for differently abled visitors and employees' -- indicating ongoing/partial rather than complete upgrades.
extraction.recruitment_details: The Company's DE&I Council partnered with key agencies to conduct 'PwD job mapping' -- identifying/mapping roles suitable for persons with disabilities -- alongside the facility access audit. No hiring numbers, targets, or attainment figures tied to this job-mapping initiative are given.
extraction.compliance_details: In response to the mandated RPwD Act 2016 accessibility question, the Company answers 'Yes,' citing DE&I Council job-mapping and facility-access-audit work that 'made locations accessible.' It also states its policy and practice is 'to comply with all applicable fair employment practices in line with Right of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.' However, for visitor accessibility it separately states infrastructure 'continues to modify' at certain locations, indicating compliance is ongoing rather than fully attained. No RPwD Act hiring-quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is stated.
